headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer | TypeScript, React & Node.js
summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with a proven track record of engineering and deploying 150+ high-performance web applications across 12+ countries. Specializes in building robust, scalable systems using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with a strong focus on end-to-end delivery from database design to pixel-perfect React frontends. Experienced in architecting REST APIs, implementing server-side tracking, and optimizing system performance for real-world conditions. Proven ability to bridge technical complexity with business goals, ensuring maintainable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable outcomes and client satisfaction.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer & Creative Strategist
bullets: Architected and deployed 150+ successful full-stack web applications for clients across 12+ countries, achieving 100% client satisfaction through robust backend and frontend solutions.
Engineered scalable REST APIs and complex data models using Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, ensuring type safety and performance under high-load conditions.
Developed performant, accessible user interfaces using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, focusing on clean architecture, state management, and pixel-perfect design implementation.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines and automated testing strategies (unit and functional) to maintain zero-vulnerability deployment standards and accelerate team velocity.
Optimized database queries and server-side logic to improve application performance, reducing load times and enhancing the overall user experience.

cover_letter: I am excited to apply for the Senior Full Stack Engineer role at Fueled. With a track record of delivering 150+ high-performance web applications, I bring deep expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js. I thrive on owning end-to-end solutions, from designing scalable data schemas in PostgreSQL to crafting pixel-perfect, accessible frontends. My background in remote collaboration and proactive problem-solving aligns perfectly with Fueled's culture of flexibility and technical excellence. I am eager to contribute to your team's mission of building premium digital experiences for world-class brands.

screening.q: Do you have experience with TypeScript?
Do you have experience with React and Next.js?
Do you have experience with Node.js and Express?
Do you have experience with database design (PostgreSQL/SQL)?
Do you have experience with CI/CD pipelines?
